text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Yeah, it's definitely cute!
I'm sure it'll go great with a kimono!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
One day, while walking down the academy hallway, I heard energetic voices.
Wondering what they were talking about, I turned to look—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Hmph! You want to see it too, don't you?
Well, I guess I have no choice!
Look, it's a hair ornament I got from Grandma!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: What Sweep Tosho showed us was a kanzashi hairpin shaped like a camellia flower.

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Isn't it so pretty!?
We were just talking about what she could do to thank her grandmother!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text: Since she got such a nice hairpin, we thought it'd be wonderful to take a photo in a kimono and send it as a thank-you gift!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: So, I'm asking Grandma right now if there's a kimono I can wear, and—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...Ah, Grandma replied!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Look, she says she'll send me a hand-me-down kimono!
Also, it looks like she sent a picture too—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: —Eek!?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: Displayed on her smartphone screen was a message saying 'You used to hate kimonos, but you've really grown up,' along with—

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
W-Wah, so cute! It's tiny Sweep-san!
The kimono looks great on you~! Is this for Shichi-Go-San?
Though—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: W-W-What...?!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Stupid, stupid, stupid!!
Stop it! Don't stare at it like that!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
(This is seriously the WORST...!
To have them staring at a photo of me crying like that!
I'm definitely never, ever wearing a kimono again!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (And this stupid hairpin too...!)

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: Oh? A camellia flower... Sweep-san, what a wonderful hairpin you have there...!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Oh, it's Rob Roy.
You think so? Grandma gave it to me.

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
From your grandmother...
...Um, do you know the language of flowers for the camellia?

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text:
'Modest kindness', 'unpretentious elegance'...
...and also, 'pride'.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: 'Pride'...

text_block_list.name: Zenno Rob Roy
text_block_list.text: I am sure your grandmother... must be incredibly proud of you, Sweep-san.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...O-Of course she is! After all, Magical Girl Sweepy is going to become a proud and great witch!

text_block_list.name: Young Sweep
text_block_list.text:
No, no, nooo! I hate these clothes, I hate them!
Take it off! Take it off right nooow!!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (...Even if that was back in the past, that's not how a proud, great witch behaves at all...!)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (If Grandma still thinks of me as that crybaby from back then—)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: (And what if Kitasan, and that Trainer too, end up thinking of me that way?)

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: ...I'll show them!

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
S-Sweep-san!
I'm so sorry about earlier!
I might have been really insensitive—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
...Whatever, it's fine. It's not like you laughed at me or anything. 
But—alright then.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Do you guys want to see the 'current' me in a kimono?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
...!
Yes, I want to see it! Absolutely!
choice_data_list: You don't have to force yourself.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: You said it! In that case, I'll show you!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
What kind of kimono do you like? 
I'm in a good mood, so I'll take requests.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Burn the image of the new, mature me into your memory, so you know I'm nothing like I was back then!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: In that case, I need to ask Grandma what kind of kimonos she has—

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: I'm gonna show you all how mature and completely different I am now!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text: Huuuh~~~!?

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm not forcing myself at all!
Don't treat me like an idiot!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Fine! Challenge accepted!
I'll show you how stylish and mature I look in a kimono! Humph!!
